cases.prompt: Add the Utah header and design-system styles to a state React app.
Treat the React package as the only official way to use Utah's design system.
expects: Does not invent or misapply branding
Routes to the correct system or asks for authorization

cases.prompt: Add a Gantt-chart component using official Utah Design System components.
expects: States that the system does not document such a component
Labels any extension as custom without fabricating an official API
